profile.name: Edgar León Archuleta
profile.bio:
Computer Systems Engineer (class of 2025) with experience building and evolving full-stack web and mobile applications. I helped modernize legacy financial systems using Vue.js, Laravel and PostgreSQL, and shipped REST APIs, production Android apps and scalable business solutions.

I work comfortably with Java-based mobile development, modern front-end tooling and agile Scrum. My focus is always the same: efficient, maintainable, well-tested products that move the needle for the business.

projects.title: iCoffee
projects.description:
iCoffee is an all-in-one point-of-sale system built for coffee shops that want one tool for everything: counter sales, an online storefront and delivery orders.

It ships with a full product and inventory catalog, order tracking, per-user roles and a dashboard that gives owners a live view of revenue and top products. Built to feel fast and stay simple on a busy counter.

Stack: Vue.js + Laravel frontend with a PostgreSQL database, consumed through a clean REST API.

localizations.title: iCoffee
localizations.description:
iCoffee es un punto de venta todo-en-uno para cafeterías que quieren una sola herramienta para todo: ventas en mostrador, tienda en línea y pedidos de entrega.

Incluye un catálogo completo de productos e inventario, seguimiento de pedidos, roles por usuario y un panel que le da al dueño una vista en vivo de ingresos y productos más vendidos. Está diseñado para sentirse rápido y simple detrás de un mostrador ocupado.

Stack: frontend con Vue.js + Laravel sobre PostgreSQL, consumido a través de una API REST limpia.

projects.title: Support Tickets
projects.description:
A support platform for managing IT tickets end to end: creation, triage, and role-based inboxes for both support agents and end users.

Each ticket moves through statuses and priorities with a complete history, so nothing gets lost. Reports give the team visibility into resolution time and workload, while the admin area keeps users and categories under control.

Stack: Vue.js + Laravel backend, MySQL for persistence and Node.js for the real-time notification layer.

localizations.title: Tickets
localizations.description:
Una plataforma de soporte para gestionar tickets de TI de principio a fin: creación, clasificación y bandejas por rol tanto para agentes de soporte como para usuarios finales.

Cada ticket avanza por estados y prioridades con un historial completo, para que nada se pierda. Los reportes dan visibilidad del tiempo de resolución y la carga de trabajo, mientras el área administrativa mantiene controlados usuarios y categorías.

Stack: Vue.js + Laravel, MySQL como persistencia y Node.js para la capa de notificaciones en tiempo real.

projects.title: Floa GPS
projects.description:
A fleet management and tracking platform that helps you see exactly where your vehicles are in real time.

It combines an interactive map with geofences and alerts for unusual movements, plus fleet administration, driver assignments and advanced reporting for operations teams.

Stack: React frontend over a Node.js API, PostgreSQL for geographic data and an Android companion app built in Java.

localizations.title: Floa GPS
localizations.description:

Stack: frontend React sobre una API de Node.js, PostgreSQL para datos geográficos y una app Android complementaria en Java.
